title: FPL GW1 — four squad drafts
description: Four legal 100m squads for Gameweek 1, each answering a different question: owning the template core (Haaland, Bruno and Joao Pedro together), defensive-contribution volume, the easiest opening fixtures, and life without Haaland. Every pick is audited against the live FPL API for availability, budget, club limits and the position-dependent DefCon threshold.
